lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Darkness.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Weight.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Cold earth presses into my back, damp and crawling with tiny things.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The scent of moss and rot fills my lungs.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Something's wrong.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: My mind claws upward from sleep, thick and sluggish, like wading through wet sand.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Pain flares behind my eyes, sharp and disorienting.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The world tilts sideways.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: I try to move. My limbs feel distant, like they belong to someone else.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Where…?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: I manage to roll onto my side. Wet leaves cling to my skin.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Each breath scrapes my throat — shallow, expensive.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: My heart pounds, unsure if from fear or effort.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Shapes flicker at the edges of my vision — light, movement, forest.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: I lift an arm. Or... I try to.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: I need to know.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: What am I?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Blurred fingers come into view — five of them, trembling and smudged with dirt.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: I flex them. The motion is clumsy, but familiar.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: This feels right. Even if nothing else does.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Broad, flat shapes come into view — hooves, chipped and heavy with mud.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: I lift one. It moves... wrong. Like a tool I don't remember learning to use.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A chill coils in my stomach. This can't be me.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: ...Can it?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A sudden noise jolts me alert.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Leaves rustle nearby, something is moving out there.

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "Hello? Is anypony— Oh!"

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A purple figure steps from the trees, the edges of my vision still swimming.

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "What in Equestria...? Are you hurt? Please, stay still."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Four legs, a spiralled horn. My mind recoils. Impossible.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: "A… talking… horse?"

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Hearing my voice jars something loose. The sound might give me a clue...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Yes, that's definitely a male's voice.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: No doubt about it, that's a female's voice.

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "Horse? I'm a pony. A unicorn, technically."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "I'm Twilight Sparkle. And I'm... guessing you're not from around here?"

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She tilts her head — curious, but cautious.

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "I tracked a surge of wild magic here, but I never expected to find *you*."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "Hello? Is somepony there?"

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "Oh my goodness! Are you hurt?"

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "I sensed a burst of wild magic nearby. Did something happen?"

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: I blink hard. Four legs, a horn—this can't be real.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: "A... talking... horse?"

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Is this normal? It doesn't feel normal.

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "Horse? We're ponies—both of us."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "I'm Twilight Sparkle. You look a little... disoriented."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She studies me, frowning at my blank stare.

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "You may have hit your head... or been caught in a magical backlash. Maybe both."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Her brow furrows, I can almost see the gears turning behind her eyes.

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "Don't worry. We'll figure this out. But first, let's get you somewhere safe."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "Hold still. Different anatomy, but levitation works on just about anything… I think."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Purple light gathers around my arms and legs. I'm lifted a handspan from the ground—weightless, unsettling.

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "Easy… there we go."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "Here, foreleg over my withers—steady."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Her aura cushions my barrel while her shoulder props me up. Four legs wobble beneath me like newborn stilts.

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "Breathe. Find your balance."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: We stand there for a moment: me, unsure of everything, and her, watching carefully.

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "Can you tell me your name?"

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: "I... I can't..."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: "Why can't I remember anything?"

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "Memory loss, wild magic, and an unfamiliar species... This is bigger than a stray anomaly."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "Memory loss? That's… troubling."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Words stick in my throat. Confusion crushes the urge to speak.

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "It's alright. Take your time."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "We'll figure this out together. Though first…"

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "That didn't sound friendly. We should move, quickly. The Everfree isn't safe after dark."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "My library's close. Shelves on trans-dimensional theory, identity displacement, anomalous surge charts…"

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She tries to stay serious, but the sparkle in her eyes betrays her excitement.

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "I've got a library nearby. Lots of material on magical disruptions, memory loss..."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "...and I *might* have been looking for a reason to reorganize the whole section again."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: "Thank you... I don't know what else to do."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "You're welcome. You're not alone in this, not anymore."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She keeps pace beside me, magic ready in case I falter.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She walks close, matching my uncertain steps.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: "How do I know I can trust you?"

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "You don't. But you're alone, confused, and clearly not from here."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "And when things like *you* show up, it's kind of my job to get involved."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "You don't. But you're disoriented, and I don't think you ended up here by choice."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "And as Ponyville's resident magical expert, helping is what I do."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: As we leave the forest behind, something shifts in the treeline—too quick to name.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Whatever brought me here... I don't think it's finished with me.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The library is warm and welcoming, a stark contrast to the dark forest.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Books line every wall, reaching up to the ceiling.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Soft light filters through the windows, illuminating floating dust motes.

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "Welcome to my home — the Golden Oak Library!"

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "It's not much, but it's cozy."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "Let's get you settled. I want to run a quick scan — you took quite a knock back there."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Her horn glows softly, bathing me in a violet aura.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A tingling sensation ripples through my body, as if invisible threads of energy are weaving around me.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The magic probes gently — exploring, mapping, measuring.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: I hold my breath, uncertain what it might find.

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "Fascinating!"

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "I've never encountered anyone with quite your... physiology."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "Your magical signature is almost nonexistent, yet you're clearly alive and self-aware."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "And these... hands — like minotaurs, I think, but with five fingers instead of four."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She floats over a scroll and quill, scribbling notes with barely contained excitement.

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "I can't sense the usual flow of magic through you at all..."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: For a moment, she seems lost in her own world, forgetting I'm standing right in front of her.

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "Ah! Sorry. Sometimes I get carried away."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "Well, physically you're in good health, though your magical field is a little unstable."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "From what I can tell, you're a..."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "...unicorn. Though your horn's resonance is lower than expected."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That would explain the slight weight I feel on my forehead.

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "...pegasus. Your flight aura seems faint, but intact."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: I shift my shoulders, aware of unfamiliar weight on my back.

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "...earth pony. Your connection to the ground feels... distant, somehow."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: My hooves feel heavy, rooted to the floor in ways I can't explain.

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "Still, nothing some rest and food won't help restore."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "All done. You seem stable enough, at least for the moment."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "Is there anything you'd like to know?"

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "That was a wonderful conversation!"

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "I hope I was able to help answer some of your questions."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "You look exhausted. You've been through a lot today."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "Come on — let's get you somewhere warm. You've earned a break."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She gently levitates a folded blanket and pillow toward a reading nook nestled against the far wall.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Even though I'm still reeling from everything, the gentle atmosphere here is comforting.

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "The guest bed isn't much, but I promise it's softer than tree roots."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Twilight arranges the cozy corner with care. The scent of ink, dust, and aged paper clings to the air, a strangely soothing ambiance.

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "Take your time. I'll be right here if you need anything."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Fatigue tugs at my thoughts. Despite everything swirling in my mind, I ease down onto the makeshift bed.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Sleep takes me, but not gently. My mind drifts into a churning sea of sensation.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Dark shapes coil around the edges of my vision — shadows that slither and breathe.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A low whisper seeps into my thoughts, more felt than heard...

lines.speaker: crypticvoice
lines.text: "So... you've arrived. Such potential... bound by mortal flesh..."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A cold pressure brushes against my mind — ancient, ravenous. It probes where memories should be.

lines.speaker: crypticvoice
lines.text: "You cannot hide forever. We will find the key... unlock the path..."

lines.speaker: royalvoice
lines.text: "Enough! The realm of dreams is under my protection; your foul presence is not welcome here."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A flash of searing light splits the dark. The whispering presence shrieks and vanishes.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then... silence.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: I jolt awake, heart pounding. The library is quiet, its shelves standing watch under a gentle morning light.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That dream... it felt real. Too real. My head throbs, like something was forcibly pushed out of place.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then a scent draws me back, warm and sweet... pancakes?

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "You're awake! Are you alright? I heard you talking in your sleep."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "Spike just finished making breakfast; maybe food will help ground you."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Even as she speaks, the lingering echo of that cryptic whisper haunts me.

lines.speaker: spike
lines.text: "Hey there! Twilight said we had a visitor. You, uh, don't look great."

lines.speaker: spike
lines.text: "But hey — pancakes help everything. I made 'em sweet, the way I like 'em."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A small dragon with emerald spines grins at me, holding a plate piled high with steaming goods.

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "We were actually just talking about what might've happened to you."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "Two heads are better than one, right?"

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They both look at me, hopeful. My thoughts are still clouded by that bizarre dream, but maybe they can shed some insight.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The conversation with Twilight and Spike concludes, leaving me with a head full of new insights... and more questions.

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "Now that you're up and feeling a little better, I'd love to introduce you to some of my friends."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "Ponyville's not big, but it has its quirks — and some very colorful residents."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "Here, let me grab a map for you. I don't want you getting lost on your first day."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Her horn glows as she lifts a scroll from a nearby shelf and unfurls it with a practiced flick.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The parchment spreads out before me, detailed with neat hoofwriting and little hand-drawn symbols marking key spots.

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "I'll come with you to show you around. Just pick a place on the map and we'll head there together!"

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: Hello! My name is Twilight Sparkle, and I'm so happy to meet you!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You can now ask questions or continue the conversation.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: As the conversation winds down, you all drift off to sleep, feeling comfortable and safe...
